confidence_notes: Meal, coffee and draft beer use recent Perth cost-of-living aggregates; the latest city update reviewed was October 2026, so the July 2026 window is approximate. Cocktail uses a Perth cost-of-living index; wine is estimated relative to local beer. Accommodation is a holistic winter estimate without live lodging checks and is least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Perth city-level price inputs. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of Perth as a high-cost, geographically isolated Australian capital during the July winter period.
